ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Classification into lumped and distributed compliance; Pseudo-Rigid Body Models (PRBM) for analysis with emphasis on design synthesis; Variational formulations and nonlinear programming techniques for solving optimum topology, shape and size problems; Building block methods including Constraint-based Design (CBD) for synthesis from first principles; Examples of compliance in nature and engineering. Prerequisites: GE 310 or ME 370, GE 311, Math 415; Preferred knowledge in CS 357 and ME 471.
